judged_text: Attendee dedupe `guest === attendee.email` is case-sensitive, allowing an already-attending guest to be re-added

record.issue_text: Attendee dedupe `guest === attendee.email` is case-sensitive, allowing an already-attending guest to be re-added

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, existing attendees are filtered with a case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. Since neither `guest` nor `attendee.email` is normalized (e.g., to lowercase), the same email with different casing ("User@x.com" vs "user@x.com") would bypass the dedupe and be added again.
